name: monday
label: monday.com GraphQL API 2026-07 — boards and items
description: Official monday.com platform GraphQL API. Single HTTP endpoint POST https://api.monday.com/v2 (not REST). Handler: OfficialApiNode. Auth: header Authorization with the raw token (no Bearer prefix). extraHeaders send API-Version: {api_version} (default 2026-07, Current until 2026-10-01; then 2026-10). https://developer.monday.com/api-reference/docs/api-versioning. Sales CRM is a board template on this same API. OfficialApiNode does not inject GraphQL documents — INPUT must include query and optional variables. Customer owns the monday account. Never log token or column_values. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (trigger.listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Example keys match api_spec.json required/queryFrom/bodyFrom.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: board.create | board.get | board.list | board.archive | column.create | column.list | group.create | group.list | group.delete | item.create | item.get | item.list | item.update | item.delete | item.move | item.changeColumn | item.changeColumns | item.addUpdate | item.byColumn | trigger.listen. trigger.listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port).

schema.label: query
schema.description: GraphQL query or mutation string for every Monday API call (POST /v2). Official Monday.com API is GraphQL-only. Example: mutation { create_item(board_id: 123, item_name: "Task") { id } }.

schema.label: variables
schema.description: GraphQL variables object matching the query. Example: {"board_id":123,"item_name":"Task"}.

schema.label: board_kind
schema.description: Board kind for board.create (public | private | share). Wired to variables.board_kind.

schema.label: title
schema.description: Column title for column.create. Wired to variables.title.

schema.label: column_type
schema.description: Column type for column.create (e.g. text, status, date). Wired to variables.column_type.

schema.label: group_name
schema.description: Group name for group.create. Wired to variables.group_name.

schema.label: body
schema.description: Update body text for item.addUpdate. Wired to variables.body.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON. Size-capped. Never log secrets or raw PII.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: board.create | board.get | board.list | board.archive | column.create | column.list | group.create | group.list | group.delete | item.create | item.get | item.list | item.update | item.delete | item.move | item.changeColumn | item.changeColumns | item.addUpdate | item.byColumn | trigger.listen. Selecting trigger.listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: API token
configurationParameters.description: Personal API token or OAuth access token minted outside StudioQuack (StudioQuack secret). Sent as Authorization: {token} with no Bearer prefix. Never log.

configurationParameters.label: API version
configurationParameters.description: API-Version header YYYY-MM. Current is 2026-07 until 2026-10-01, then 2026-10. extraHeaders sends this on every GraphQL call. https://developer.monday.com/api-reference/docs/api-versioning

configurationParameters.label: Board Kind
configurationParameters.description: Board kind for board.create (public | private | share). Wired to variables.board_kind.

configurationParameters.label: Title
configurationParameters.description: Column title for column.create. Wired to variables.title.

configurationParameters.label: Column Type
configurationParameters.description: Column type for column.create (e.g. text, status, date). Wired to variables.column_type.

configurationParameters.label: Group Name
configurationParameters.description: Group name for group.create. Wired to variables.group_name.

configurationParameters.label: Body
configurationParameters.description: Update body text for item.addUpdate. Wired to variables.body.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 30. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
